title: Created some retro games using AI and deployed them to a website
author: Neat-Application-769
selftext:
I love playing retro browser games and as a small side project created them using AI and put them together into one website:

[https://classic2dgames.com/](https://classic2dgames.com/)

Right now it includes simple playable classics like:

* Snake
* Pong
* Breakout
* Space Invaders
* Asteroids
* Flappy Bird

Would genuinely love feedback on:

* performance
* mobile experience
* game feel
* other retro games I should add next

comments.author: EsotericLexeme
comments.body:
Dang, the retro feel is pretty much the same as on my site, https://unblockedgame.app

But on your site, even though game mechanics cannot be copyrighted, some of the names you use are under IP. So, before you start adding more games, I would recommend thinking of original names.

replies.author: Neat-Application-769
replies.body:
I really like your website and games library.

Thanks for the suggestion. I'll update the names

replies.author: EsotericLexeme
replies.body: Thanks, it started as "well I could do this" kind of project, but lately I have been spending quite a lot of time on refining the ux of new games.

comments.author: DeadSedative
comments.body: Played Snake a little. Play's well enough but I found that it wasn't accepting inputs fast enough to grab a dot near the wall and turn away from the wall before dying. Could just be my experience though due to network/pc/keyboard, not sure.

replies.author: Neat-Application-769
replies.body:
Thank you. 
I'll update the controls and the ux

replies.author: Neat-Application-769
replies.body:
Have added Google analytics for now.
Not much.
Deployed it yesterday

Nice

comments.author: hblok
comments.body:
Classic indeed. Looks good. I love the CRT glow look.

I played quickly through all, and looks mostly fine. 

With Tappy, my space key is not good enough to play. And with Defender, the very small crop makes it rather difficult - it used to take much longer before they hit the bottom, I think.

With Paddles, I got some strange ball movements. Did it wrap around the screen?

Pacman moves WAY too fast! Not playable.

Luke moves backwards. Is that intentional?

I liked the auto-jummping in Jumper. The timing of the jumping and moving always kills that game if it's manual.

I'm on Firefox 140, on a modern desktop computer.

replies.author: Neat-Application-769
replies.body:
Hey, thank you.
Yes the games are a little glitchy and need improvements.
Will work on them over the weekend 

Your browser specs are fine, the issues are in the code base.
